verdict.rationale: Khoj is an AI assistant with agents and tools, so plugging in MCP servers as a client is a fair axis to judge it on. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions MCP or any way to connect external tool servers. The only tool-related items are built-in tools (online search, code execution) and agent configuration with 'tools' [khoj-gh-1], which does not establish MCP client support.
